consumer: The border guard's contraband-search check, which asks the engine 'is the avatar carrying this contraband item within the search's reach?'
scope: The guard search's defined possession reach (the engine's own carried/searchable predicate over the avatar), not a client re-derivation over the full carried-item dump
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_carried_items — dumps wielded/worn/inventory items as raw JSON, exposing no engine-computed contraband-possession verdict
divergence: Avatar hides the contraband inside a closed/locked container or a body cavity that the guard's search predicate would NOT reach: inv_const_slice still lists it, so the dumped array says 'carrying' while the engine's search check returns 'not found' — opposite answers
